docs.title: Document check
docs.sub: Service chuniye, apne documents add kijiye aur dekhiye kya baaki hai. Sirf wahi details save hoti hain jo aap confirm karte hain. File kabhi save nahi hoti.
docs.caption: Aapki checklist par based. Approval ka andaza nahi.
docs.scanned: Aapke upload se padha gaya aur aapne confirm kiya
docs.declared: Aapne kaha ki yeh aapke paas hai. Check nahi hua
docs.hide: Photo upload karne se pehle gair-zaroori personal details chhupa lein. ID numbers sirf aakhri 4 digits mein dikhte hain.
docs.review: Jo padha gaya use check karein
docs.reviewHelp: Jo galat ho use sudhaariye, phir confirm kijiye.
docs.saveError: Save nahi ho paya. Dobara try kijiye.
docs.loadError: Load nahi ho paya. Dobara try kijiye.
docs.find_unreadable: Yeh document padha nahi ja saka. Saaf photo try kijiye.
docs.find_blurry: Photo blurry lag rahi hai. Saaf photo se behtar result milta hai.
docs.find_low_resolution: Photo chhoti hai. Badi photo se behtar result milta hai.
docs.err_unsupported_type: JPG, PNG ya PDF file use kijiye.
docs.err_ocr_unavailable: Abhi documents padhna available nahi hai.
docs.err_unknown_doc_type: Yeh document type supported nahi hai.
docs.err_other: File padhi nahi ja saki. Dobara try kijiye.

drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.sub: Complaint, RTI application ya grievance ka draft banaiye. Kuch bhi kahin bheja nahi jaata. Aap har field check karte hain, phir PDF download karte hain.
drafts.complaint: Service mein deri ya inkaar ki complaint
drafts.f_authority: Public authority (jis office se pooch rahe hain)
drafts.f_bpl: Main BPL (Below Poverty Line) applicant hoon
drafts.hide: Poora Aadhaar, PAN, phone ya bank number mat likhiye. Likhenge to sirf aakhri 4 digits rakhe jayenge.
drafts.reviewHelp: PDF mein bilkul yahi hoga. Jo galat ho sudhaariye, phir box tick kijiye.
drafts.checked: Maine har field check kar li hai
drafts.changed: Review ke baad aapne kuch badla. Dobara check kijiye.
drafts.failed: PDF ready nahi ho paya. Dobara try kijiye.
drafts.notice: Fees, address aur deadlines hum nahi bharte. Bhejne se pehle official source se confirm kijiye.
